description: Phishing templates impersonating Microsoft products and services

templates.name: Microsoft Account Suspicious Sign-In
suggested_subject_lines: Action required: Review recent sign-in from Bogotá, Colombia
Security alert: Unrecognized device accessed your Microsoft account
templates.notes: Use {{.Date}} for current date realism. The specific location (Bogotá) adds believability. Works across all Microsoft 365 users.

templates.name: Microsoft OneDrive — Shared Document
suggested_subject_lines: OneDrive: A document has been shared with you
Action Required: View FY2026 Budget Plan Draft
templates.notes: Highly realistic document sharing notification. Best targeted at finance, accounting, or administrative teams who handle Excel spreadsheets.

templates.name: Microsoft Teams — Missed Chat Notification
suggested_subject_lines: You have missed activity in Microsoft Teams
Direct message from IT Support Helpdesk
Urgent: Check your missed messages in Microsoft Teams
templates.notes: Urgent chat notification lure. Simulating IT support drives high compliance. Best targeted at general staff on active chat platforms.

templates.name: Microsoft Security — Mandatory MFA Re-enrollment
suggested_subject_lines: Action Required: Re-verify your Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) device
Microsoft Security: Mandatory MFA security policy update
Important: Re-enroll your authentication device within 24 hours
templates.notes: Advanced compliance-driven security lure. Exploits employee obedience to IT directives. Works well during company-wide IT policy updates.
